decisions.reason: Adding a header navigation menu does not change the existing requirement to use a common header, footer, and visual treatment across website pages.

The agent diagram is located on a page reachable through the new menu, but its production-ready design requirement is not changed by the navigation decision.
The platform diagram is located on an associated solution page, but the header-menu decision does not change its placement, source artifact, or deliverable.
The source does not establish that the new website header menu applies to or changes the Account Provisioning wizard's page treatment.
